description: OpenAI/DeepSeek function-calling tool definitions for AI Engineering Guard (AEG)

function.name: aeg_check
function.description: Run AI Engineering Guard quality check (diff -> impact -> risk -> deduplicated test plan -> exact cache -> test execution -> quality gate) and return the minimal token-efficient agent-summary JSON.

base.description: Optional base Git ref, e.g. origin/main

function.name: aeg_explain_risk
function.description: Explain why the current change received its deterministic L0-L4 risk level.

function.name: aeg_explain_test
function.description: Explain why a specific test suite was selected, cached, blocked, or marked not_required.

function.name: aeg_inspect_failure
function.description: Fetch structured failure details from the latest AEG run (progressive disclosure).

function.name: aeg_inspect_log
function.description: Read a bounded, secret-redacted log slice for a failed test suite artifact.

function.name: aeg_config_validate
function.description: Validate .engineering-guard/{config,modules,tests}.yaml against JSON Schema and cross-references.
